name: ai-usage-meter
displayName: Claude Code Usage & Codex Usage Cost Meter
description: See today's Claude Code and Codex tokens and estimated cost in the status bar, with the Claude Code 5-hour block, Codex rate limits and a 30-day dashboard. Offline. Not affiliated with Anthropic or OpenAI.

aiUsageMeter.showClaudeCode.description: Show Claude Code usage in the status bar and the dashboard.

aiUsageMeter.showCodex.description: Show Codex usage and rate limits in the status bar and the dashboard.

aiUsageMeter.statusBar.description: Show the usage item in the status bar.

aiUsageMeter.statusBarCost.description: Show the estimated cost next to the token count in the status bar.

aiUsageMeter.refreshSeconds.description: Read new lines from the session files at least this often (seconds). File changes also trigger a read within 2 seconds.

aiUsageMeter.historyDays.description: Read usage from this many past days. Files not changed in that time are skipped.

aiUsageMeter.prices.markdownDescription: Your own prices in US dollars per million tokens, by model id or model id prefix. A row here replaces the built-in row for that model. The built-in prices were taken on 2026-11-06 and are estimates. Example: `{ "claude-opus-5-5": { "input": 4, "output": 20, "cacheWrite": 5, "cacheRead": 0.2 } }`

aiUsageMeter.claudeRoots.markdownDescription: Folders that hold Claude Code projects. Empty = `$CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/projects`, else `~/.claude/projects`.

aiUsageMeter.codexRoots.markdownDescription: Folders that hold Codex `rollout-*.jsonl` files. Empty = `$CODEX_HOME/sessions`, else `~/.codex/sessions`.

aiUsageMeter.askForRating.description: Ask one time for a Marketplace rating after you have used the dashboard for a few days. You can answer "Later" or "Don't ask again". Nothing is sent anywhere.

aiUsageMeter.showSupportLinks.description: Show the small Sponsor and More free viewers links at the end of the dashboard. Nothing is sent anywhere.

walkthroughs.title: Get started with Claude Code & Codex Usage
walkthroughs.description: Track tokens, estimated cost and limits for Claude Code and Codex. Nothing leaves your machine.

steps.title: Read the status bar
steps.description: The item at the right of the status bar shows today's tokens and estimated cost per tool, the time left in the Claude Code 5-hour block and the Codex limits. Hover it for details.

steps.title: Open the dashboard
steps.description:
Totals per day, project folder, model and tool, with a 30-day chart.
[Open Usage Dashboard](command:aiUsageMeter.openDashboard)

media.altText: The usage dashboard with today tiles, the 5-hour block, Codex limits and a stacked bar chart per day.

steps.title: Check the prices
steps.description:
Costs are estimates from a price table. Change any row to match your plan or a new model.
[Edit Price Table](command:aiUsageMeter.editPrices)
